svg.title: From the demo board to the silicon
svg.text: From the board to the silicon
Tiny Tapeout chips arrive in a QFN package on a carrier board that plugs into the demo board. Every project on the shuttle shares one die, behind a multiplexer.
RP2350 and USB-C; the Pmod headers
carry the QSPI memory and I/O
the chip in its QFN package,
on a socket you can swap
Panels 1–3 are illustrations, not to scale. Panel 4 is the design's real standard cells. The routed layout appears after the GitHub hardening run.
